title: Scalable iconography and screenshot safe-zones for quickstart — accessibility & dark-mode pass
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Deliver a comprehensive accessibility and dark-mode pass for the quickstart onboarding assets. Focus areas: 1) a new scalable stroke-based icon set that maintains legibility across 12–48px sizes and multiple contrast ratios; 2) clearly defined screenshot safe-zones and mock data variants for dark/light themes to avoid text clipping and low-contrast text over images; 3) token-count and progress badges with accessible color ramps and non-color indicators for low-vision users; 4) updated export checklist for release screenshots and docs visuals.
acceptance_criteria: Icon set includes 60 glyphs exported as stroke-based SVGs with 3 stroke weights and optimized hinting for 12, 16, 24, 32, 48px sizes
All primary quickstart screenshots have defined 16px safe-zone margins and at least two high-contrast mock data variants (realistic and privacy-safe)
Contrast ratios meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 for UI text and 3:1 for large text in both themes; token-count badges meet AA at 12px with added shape indicator
Figma spec page with examples and an Export checklist is reviewed and approved by PM and ENG
Automated visual-diff tests added to screenshot pipeline and passing in CI
decisions: Choose stroke-based icons over filled glyphs to preserve recognizability at smaller sizes
Introduce a 'dot' non-color indicator inside badges for colorblind/low-vision variants
Use 16px inner safe-zone for screenshots to support cropping on mobile and marketplace thumbnails
tasks: Audit existing quickstart icons and mark candidates for replacement (DES-34620)
Create 3 stroke weights and export tokens for 12/16/24/32/48px
Define screenshot safe-zone overlay component and add to console export tool (ENG-41234)
Author Figma spec page and checklist for release designers
Add visual-diff tests to screenshots CI and wire to PR gating
